svg.aria-label: cli-rotator: offline test suite against a fake CLI
svg.text: cli-rotator: offline test suite against a fake CLI

g.text: ok 1 - config validation: a good config passes; each mistake is named
ok 2 - CLI: a broken config exits 2 with every error in one JSON line
ok 3 - durations and reset rules
ok 4 - bench state: newest wall decides, a later success clears it, an expired bench is no bench
ok 5 - budget window and rotation order: least busy, then least used, then config order
ok 6 - memory gate decisions
ok 7 - expect verdict: ok, missing, claimed-success-but-missing, stub, stale, no-sentinel
ok 8 - parseArgs: flags, passthrough after --, and errors
ok 9 - rotation: three runs on three fresh accounts land on a, b, c in turn
ok 10 - rotation: the least-used account in the ledger goes first
ok 11 - wall: the account is benched until the reset it printed and the run moves to the next accoun
t
ok 12 - bench expiry: a wall whose reset has passed rejoins the rotation
ok 13 - every account walled: exit 3, and a second run starts nothing
ok 14 - daily budget: a spent account is skipped; all spent is exit 3
ok 15 - expect verdicts through the CLI: the file, not the exit code, decides
ok 16 - a non-quota failure does not rotate by default (no second paid run); rotateOn any-failure do
es
ok 17 - timeout: a hung CLI is killed when its minutes run out, and is not retried elsewhere
ok 18 - memory gate: at 95% the run is refused with exit 4 and the CLI never starts
ok 19 - concurrent runs spread across accounts (in-flight markers), not all onto the least-used one
ok 20 - environment: scrubbed variables never reach the CLI, envFrom copies a value by name, dry-run
prints names only
ok 21 - --help and --status succeed
ok 2 - test\\fixtures\\fake-cli.mjs

text.tspan: # (the fake CLI fixture is picked up by node --test as a file; it exits 0 when run that way)
